requirements.title: ACM Problem-Solving Platform
requirements.description: A website designed to help users solve ACM programming problems efficiently.

features.name: Problem Repository
features.description: A comprehensive collection of ACM programming problems categorized by difficulty and topic.

features.name: Code Submission System
features.description: Allows users to submit their code and receive instant feedback on correctness and performance.

features.name: Leaderboard
features.description: Displays rankings of users based on their problem-solving performance and speed.

features.name: Tutorials and Hints
features.description: Provides educational resources and hints to help users understand and solve problems.

features.name: User Profiles
features.description: Allows users to create profiles to track their progress and achievements.

constraints: Must handle high traffic and concurrent users
requirements.target_users: Students, competitive programmers, and ACM enthusiasts
requirements.data_requirements: Storage for user profiles, problem data, submissions, and leaderboard information

tasks.name: Design Problem Repository UI
tasks.description: Create the frontend interface for browsing and searching ACM problems.

tasks.name: Implement Problem Repository Backend
tasks.description: Develop the backend system to store and retrieve ACM problems.

tasks.name: Set Up Problem Repository Database
tasks.description: Design and implement the database schema for storing ACM problems.

tasks.name: Develop Code Submission UI
tasks.description: Create the frontend interface for users to submit their code solutions.

tasks.name: Implement Code Submission Backend
tasks.description: Develop the backend system to handle code submissions and execute them securely.

tasks.name: Set Up Code Submission Database
tasks.description: Design and implement the database schema for storing code submissions and results.

tasks.name: Create Leaderboard UI
tasks.description: Design the frontend interface for displaying user rankings and scores.

tasks.name: Implement Leaderboard Backend
tasks.description: Develop the backend system to calculate and update user rankings.

tasks.name: Set Up Leaderboard Database
tasks.description: Design and implement the database schema for storing user scores and rankings.

tasks.name: Develop Tutorials and Hints UI
tasks.description: Create the frontend interface for accessing tutorials and hints for problems.

tasks.name: Implement Tutorials and Hints Backend
tasks.description: Develop the backend system to manage and serve tutorials and hints.

tasks.name: Set Up Tutorials and Hints Database
tasks.description: Design and implement the database schema for storing tutorials and hints.

tasks.name: Create User Profiles UI
tasks.description: Design the frontend interface for user profiles, including settings and activity tracking.

tasks.name: Implement User Profiles Backend
tasks.description: Develop the backend system to manage user profiles and activity data.

tasks.name: Set Up User Profiles Database
tasks.description: Design and implement the database schema for storing user profile information.

tasks.name: Test Problem Repository Functionality
tasks.description: Perform testing on the problem repository to ensure it works as expected.

tasks.name: Test Code Submission System
tasks.description: Perform testing on the code submission system to ensure secure and accurate execution.

tasks.name: Test Leaderboard Functionality
tasks.description: Perform testing on the leaderboard to ensure rankings are calculated correctly.

tasks.name: Test Tutorials and Hints System
tasks.description: Perform testing on the tutorials and hints system to ensure content is accessible.

tasks.name: Test User Profiles Functionality
tasks.description: Perform testing on user profiles to ensure data is accurate and settings are functional.

tasks.name: Deploy Problem-Solving Platform
tasks.description: Deploy the ACM Problem-Solving Platform to a production environment.

T1.implementation_approach: Design a user-friendly interface for browsing, searching, and filtering problems using modern UI frameworks like React or Angular.
T1.notes: Ensure responsive design for compatibility across devices.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop backend APIs to handle problem creation, retrieval, and updates using a framework like Node.js or Django.
T2.notes: Focus on secure and scalable API design.

T3.implementation_approach: Set up a relational database (e.g., PostgreSQL) to store problem data including metadata and tags.
T3.notes: Define clear schema for efficient querying.

T4.implementation_approach: Design a UI for users to submit code solutions with syntax highlighting and error feedback.
T4.notes: Integrate real-time validation for better user experience.

T5.implementation_approach: Develop backend APIs to handle code submission, execution, and result storage using a secure execution environment.
T5.notes: Implement sandboxing to prevent malicious code execution.

T6.implementation_approach: Set up a database to store code submissions, execution results, and timestamps.
T6.notes: Ensure proper indexing for fast retrieval of submission history.

T7.implementation_approach: Design a leaderboard UI to display rankings based on user performance and problem-solving metrics.
T7.notes: Include filters for time range and problem categories.

T8.implementation_approach: Develop backend APIs to calculate and update leaderboard rankings dynamically.
T8.notes: Optimize ranking algorithms for large datasets.

T9.implementation_approach: Set up a database to store leaderboard data including user scores and rankings.

T10.implementation_approach: Design a UI for tutorials and hints with interactive elements like videos, text, and quizzes.
T10.notes: Make tutorials accessible and easy to navigate.

T11.implementation_approach: Develop backend APIs to manage tutorial content and hint retrieval based on user progress.
T11.notes: Implement caching for frequently accessed content.

T12.implementation_approach: Set up a database to store tutorial content, hints, and user progress data.

T13.implementation_approach: Design a UI for user profiles to display personal information, achievements, and activity history.

T14.implementation_approach: Develop backend APIs to manage user profile data including updates and retrieval.
T14.notes: Ensure secure handling of sensitive user information.

T15.implementation_approach: Set up a database to store user profile data including preferences and activity logs.

T16.implementation_approach: Test problem repository functionality including problem creation, retrieval, and filtering.
T16.notes: Use automated and manual testing methods.

T17.implementation_approach: Test code submission system for correctness, security, and performance under various scenarios.
T17.notes: Simulate edge cases and high traffic conditions.

T18.implementation_approach: Test leaderboard functionality for accurate ranking updates and data consistency.

T19.implementation_approach: Test tutorials and hints system for content accessibility and user progress tracking.

T20.implementation_approach: Test user profiles functionality including data updates, retrieval, and security measures.

T21.implementation_approach: Deploy the platform on a cloud service like AWS or Azure with proper CI/CD pipelines.
T21.notes: Monitor performance and address post-deployment issues promptly.
